cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4M_IndependentSteering_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

R4M_IndependentSteering_ServoDrum.role: static servo drum, motor, pinion bearing, yaw scale ring

R4M_IndependentSteering_Pinion.role: servo pinion: rotates about local Y (Unity up); ratio 2.65 : 1 to the knuckle

R4M_IndependentSteering_Knuckle.role: steering knuckle: yaws about local Y (kingpin through the cell centre), visual limit +-35 deg

Hub_Mount.role: hub flange face (+X) for the steered wheel/part

notes: No runtime placeholder geometry exists for IndependentSteering (block only); yaw limit is visual - SteeringMode / IndependentYaw stay runtime.
